response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS region_avg_balance FROM acc GROUP BY region), m AS (SELECT region, region_avg_amount, region_avg_balance, AVG(region_avg_amount) OVER () AS mean_amt FROM reg) SELECT region, region_avg_amount, region_avg_balance, region_avg_amount * 1.0 / mean_amt AS amount_ratio FROM m WHERE mean_amt IS NOT NULL
